session2.title: Local AI Testing (It Failed)
session2.content: Tried running MusicGen and AudioLDM2 on student hardware with no GPU. Results: 4-10 seconds per sound. Way too slow for any gameplay that needs fast reactions. Local-only AI generation isn't viable yet.

session4.title: Stress-Testing the Hybrid Approach
session4.content: Combined procedural audio with cloud AI in a hybrid system. Pushed it hard: 100 simultaneous requests handled in under 200ms. Hit 2253 generations per second. Procedural path runs at 5ms, cloud path at 2-4 seconds. The hybrid model works for production.
